content: {"items":[{"passage_kind":"NARRATIVE_EVIDENCE","statement":"The consulted source reports that Pedro Lantzas was an agent of the Spanish in the service of the Spanish crown in the realm of the Kingdom of Naples, as revealed through his secret conversations with the count of Miranda, viceroy of Naples (1586-1595), during the period of 1595 when the sultan called Peribei to Constantinople to join the diván.","evidence_id":"e-e58d6d310437ea3cec1b","passage_ids":[5],"kind":"source_statement","source_type":"UNVERIFIED","actors":["Pedro Lantzas"],"places":[],"dates":["1595"],"usage_type":"UNRESOLVED","uncertainty":["ORIGINAL_NOT_INSPECTED","SOURCE_GENEALOGY_PENDING","INDEPENDENCE_UNRESOLVED","MULTIPLE_DATES_REQUIRE_CLAUSE_REVIEW","ACTION_UNRESOLVED"]},{"passage_kind":"NARRATIVE_EVIDENCE","statement":"The consulted source reports that Pedro Lantzas was involved in the secret negotiations between Peribei and the count of Miranda, viceroy of Naples, and that he was responsible for transmitting the information to Dionisio, who later made promises to visit Naples to meet with the viceroy and Lantzas.","evidence_id":"e-e58d6d310437ea3cec1b","passage_ids":[5,9],"kind":"source_statement","source_type":"UNVERIFIED","actors":["Pedro Lantzas","Dionisio"],"places":[],"dates":[],"usage_type":"UNRESOLVED","uncertainty":["ORIGINAL_NOT_INSPECTED","SOURCE_GENEALOGY_PENDING","INDEPENDENCE_UNRESOLVED","MULTIPLE_DATES_REQUIRE_CLAUSE_REVIEW","ACTION_UNRESOLVED"]}]}
